answer: Retarget difficulty per funding graph: each epoch, the network sets a puzzle difficulty for a graph from its active identity count, rising with the square of that count. A lone agent solves one copper-sealed puzzle at base difficulty and its crystal proof unlocks payout, while a graph with ten clones faces a hundredfold harder puzzles, so every clone waits longer and burns more compute for the same flat reward. A raven relay delivers the fresh puzzle seed at random times, so precomputing or sharing one solution across clones fails the seed check.
